info.title: FluentCRM API
info.description: Complete REST API documentation for FluentCRM — a self-hosted email marketing and CRM plugin for WordPress.

post.description:
Send a message into an existing conversation from the Inbox, on the thread's own channel. The send runs inline (no queue); the message row is written as `pending` before the provider is called and updated to `sent` or `failed`, so a request that dies leaves a record. On a provider failure the response is 422 and still carries `sent_message` (with `status: failed` and `error_message`).

**Text** (`message_type` omitted or `text`): `content` is required (422 `Write a message first.` when blank).
- **SMS**: always allowed (no session window).
- **WhatsApp 24-hour rule**: free-form text is accepted only while the contact's last inbound message is less than 24 hours old (`session.has_active_session`). Outside the window the call returns **409** `This WhatsApp conversation is outside its 24-hour window, so only an approved template can be sent.` Send a template instead.

**Template** (`message_type = template`): WhatsApp only (422 on SMS threads). Needs `template_name` and optionally `template_language` (or `language`); the template must be approved for the current provider (422 `Pick an approved template.`). Variables in `template_variables` are rendered against the thread's linked contact. The thread needs a phone number, and the provider must support templates (409 otherwise). Templates are allowed inside or outside the 24-hour window. The stored message `content` is the template body text.

409 is also returned when Pro is inactive or the channel is not configured/active. This endpoint does not check the thread's consent `status`; the profile-level `POST /messaging/subscribers/{id}/send` does. **PRO** (FluentCampaign Pro Messaging module).

<!-- fc:access -->

**Required capability:** `fcrm_read_emails` or `fcrm_manage_emails` — which one applies depends on the action being performed.

_Enforced by `InboxPolicy::verifyRequest()`, the policy default for this route group._

**Requires:** FluentCampaign Pro **with the Messaging module enabled**. While no messaging channel (SMS or WhatsApp) is switched on the route is not registered at all and returns a 404.

<!-- /fc:access -->

content.description: Message body. Required for text messages; ignored for templates.

template_language.description: Template language code, e.g. `en_US`. Alias: `language`. When omitted the first approved template with that name is used.

template_variables.description: Values for the template's placeholders, passed to the template renderer.

401.description: Not authenticated — missing or invalid credentials.

403.description: Authenticated but the user lacks the capability this route requires.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist.

422.description: Empty content, invalid/unapproved template, template sent on SMS, or the provider rejected the send (body then includes `sent_message` with `status: failed`).

409.description: Outside the WhatsApp 24-hour window (text), channel unavailable, or provider has no template support.

MessageThread.description: A conversation: one phone number on one channel. Unique on (channel, phone_number).

phone_number.description: The conversation's phone number, as stored.

profile_name.description: WhatsApp profile name from the thread meta, or an empty string.

wa_id.description: WhatsApp ID from the thread meta, or an empty string.

status.description: Consent status of this number on this channel.

unread_count.description: Inbound messages after the last-seen cursor (stored cache).

updated_at.description: Time of the newest message activity (`Y-m-d H:i:s`). Marking a thread seen or changing consent does not touch it.

MessageSession.description: WhatsApp 24-hour customer-service window, derived from the newest inbound message. SMS threads always report an open window with a null expiry.

has_active_session.description: True while free-form messages may be sent. Always true for SMS. For WhatsApp, true only if the contact's last inbound message is less than 24 hours old.

expires_at.description: When the window closes (`Y-m-d H:i:s`, site time). Null for SMS and for WhatsApp threads with no inbound message. For a WhatsApp thread whose window already closed this is the time it closed.

MessageThreadContact.description: The linked CRM contact, or null when the number is not a contact.

lists.description: List titles. Only present on single-thread payloads (`thread` objects), not on the conversation rail.

tags.description: Tag titles. Only present on single-thread payloads.

MessageThreadPreview.description: Preview of the thread's newest message. Populated on the list endpoint only; always null on single-thread payloads.

text.description: Message content, or the first attachment's caption / filename when the content is empty.

ThreadMessage.description: One message in a thread, as shaped for the Inbox.

message_type.description: Derived, not stored: `media` when the meta holds attachments, `template` when it references a template, otherwise `text`.

content.description: Message body. For a template send this is the template's body text, not the rendered variables.

template_name.description: Template name for template messages, else an empty string.

media.description: Attachment objects from the message meta (shape depends on the provider, typically `type`, `url`, `filename`, `caption`).

error_message.description: The provider's refusal reason for a failed message, else an empty string.

created_at.description: Effective message time, `Y-m-d H:i:s`: `sent_at`, falling back to `scheduled_at`, then `created_at`.
